label: Role
text: Senior Frontend Engineer at Cazoo (formerly Motors.co.uk), Glasgow, UK, remote, July 2022 – August 2026.

label: Team and product
text: Frontend engineer in a cross-functional squad (backend, QA, design, product manager, engineering manager) on Motors.co.uk, a UK car marketplace with ~250,000 vehicles from 4,000+ dealers and 500–700k monthly users (~1M sessions a month).

label: React 17 → 19
text: Upgraded the ASP.NET/React (ReactJS.NET) monolith from React 17 to 19 in two phases: moved rendering to hydrateRoot and refactored the server-rendered views onto a new renderComponent API (70+ files), moved the build to Node 22, upgraded Cypress, and adopted React 19 patterns (use(), no forwardRef) with Sentry error classification.

label: Redux → Zustand
text: Replaced Redux entirely with Zustand in the monolith (16 domain slices: search, shortlist, lead forms, account, dealer reviews, vehicle pages; ~240 files) and documented the new store for the team, then adopted the React Compiler and removed manual useMemo/useCallback.

label: GA4
text: Moved analytics to GA4 across both web apps: rebuilt the Next.js app's tracking on a single data layer (page, navigation and e-commerce events; 58 files) and removed the legacy Universal Analytics tracking and old GTM container from the monolith (300+ files).

label: GrowthBook feature flags
text: Connected the Next.js app to GrowthBook feature flags served by the monolith, sent experiment exposure events to the GA4 data layer, and built an internal page and debug badge to QA flags before release.

label: OneTrust lazy-loading
text: Lazy-loaded the OneTrust consent banner in the monolith after the page's load event, taking a third-party script out of the initial page load as part of the team's Core Web Vitals work.

label: Shared Radix modals
text: Migrated the monolith's modals to a shared Modal component built on Radix UI, together with another engineer.

label: Cross-functional work
text: Worked day to day with backend, QA, design and the product manager from planning to release.

label: Project
text: Form:at, an offline-first PWA for a Glasgow electronic music collective: personal project, built solo, May 2026 – present. Live at formatglasgow.com; code at github.com/Zitric/form-at.

label: Offline audio
text: Designed, built and run in production on my own (500+ commits): a PWA that saves 90-minute mixes (100–220MB each) for playback with no signal, using IndexedDB with a storage-quota pre-flight, a custom service worker that serves HTTP Range requests for seeking, and lock-screen playback through the Media Session API.

label: Cloudflare stack
text: Full stack on Cloudflare: TanStack Start (React 19) on Pages/Workers, D1 (SQLite) for the catalogue and analytics, R2 for audio with versioned immutable keys, direct-to-R2 presigned uploads for 220MB files, and Web Push sending that runs on Workers.

label: Admin dashboard
text: Admin dashboard behind Cloudflare Access, with server-side JWT verification on every write endpoint; a scheduled Worker archives real-user-monitoring data into D1.

label: Monorepo and tooling
text: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with a shared design system (Storybook, Chromatic visual tests), Vitest and Playwright tests on Chromium and WebKit, and CI/CD on GitHub Actions; built AI-assisted with Claude Code under a written agent working agreement (CLAUDE.md).
